inherits_protocol.inheritance: All scientific windows, finite-difference definitions, model tiers, breakpoint rules, causal branch rules, future-leakage gates, state-sufficiency tests, runtime boundaries and probe contracts are inherited unchanged.

supersession_reason: Formal V2 execution rejected source run entry-481b86f81d58d496a687 at optimizer step 2200 because batch_selection_order was absent. A complete source audit established that 4 of 13 runs captured this optional object and 9 did not, while every run captured exactly one content-addressed training_batch_inputs and training_batch_targets object at each training opportunity.

batch_identity_availability_contract.training_batch_inputs: Exactly one content-addressed source object is required at every training opportunity.
batch_identity_availability_contract.training_batch_targets: Exactly one content-addressed source object is required at every training opportunity.
batch_identity_availability_contract.batch_selection_order: At most one source object is admitted. When present it is preserved exactly. When absent, no order is reconstructed or guessed; the outcome position records ExplicitDisposition(SOURCE_BATCH_SELECTION_ORDER_NOT_CAPTURED_IN_PARTICIPANT_GFG).
batch_identity_availability_contract.replay_semantics: The native training operation consumes the captured ordered input and target tensors. The optional selection-order object is provenance about how that already ordered batch was selected, not an additional numerical input required to replay the native forward/backward/update operation.
batch_identity_availability_contract.multiple_object_rule: More than one object for any required or optional batch role remains a fail-closed error.

failed_predecessor_evidence_policy: The partial Formal V2 execution and its failure log are retained unchanged and are never relabeled as Formal V3 evidence.
